description: This file defines the `absl::string_view` class, a lightweight, non-owning view into a string, designed as a drop-in replacement for C++17's `std::string_view`. It includes constructors, member functions, comparison operators, and utility functions for string view manipulation.

classes.name: absl::string_view
classes.description: A lightweight, non-owning view into a string, providing methods for string manipulation, comparison, and iteration without copying data.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison between two string_view objects.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality comparison between two string_view objects.
